text: KuroWhale（DSH 桌面插件，Desktop 客户端）：在 Windows 桌面显示一只会随 DSH Agent 活动变化的鲸鱼娘桌宠。插件监听会话事件和 agent 状态，把审批等待、执行、完成回顾及失败等状态映射为九种动画，并在独立透明悬浮窗中播放。用户可通过右键菜单和系统托盘拖动、缩放、隐藏、置顶、居中或关闭桌宠，也可选择动画作诊断。位置和显示偏好保存在本地。适合希望直观看到 Agent 工作状态的用户；需要 Windows x64、WebView2 和兼容版本的 DSH Desktop，首次运行可能下载素材及 Neutralino 运行时。

KuroWhale is a Windows DSH desktop pet that maps agent activity to nine animations in a transparent window. Menu and tray control position, size, visibility, and pinning. Preferences are saved locally. Requires Windows x64, WebView2, and compatible DSH Desktop.
想在 Windows 桌面上放一个会跟着 DSH Agent 工作状态变化的桌宠。
希望不用盯着 DSH 窗口，也能看出 Agent 是在运行、等待审批还是已经结束。
能不能把 DSH 会话的执行状态用桌面动画显示出来？
想要一个可以拖动、缩放和置顶的透明桌面宠物。
DSH Agent 等审批或运行失败时，有没有桌面上的状态提示？
我想从系统托盘重新显示隐藏的桌面宠物。
I want a desktop companion that changes its animation with my DSH agent activity.
Can I see approval waits and completed or failed turns without watching the main DSH window?
KuroWhale 的功能「会话状态动画」：根据 DSH 会话事件和 Agent 状态切换待机、运行、审批等待、失败及完成回顾等动画。插件监听事件后映射状态并显示。
KuroWhale 的功能「桌面窗口控制」：桌宠在透明独立窗口中显示，可拖动、缩放、隐藏、置顶、居中或关闭；右键菜单提供控制入口，系统托盘可恢复显示。
KuroWhale 的功能「保存显示偏好」：插件将窗口坐标、缩放、可见性和置顶状态写入本地 position.json，并在启动时读取这些设置恢复位置与外观。
KuroWhale 的功能「动画诊断」：用户可在桌宠菜单选择动画状态，或运行完整状态轮播检查动画；恢复自动状态后重新跟随 Agent 活动。
KuroWhale 需要 Windows x64；首次启动可能从固定来源下载桌宠素材及 Neutralino 运行时。

dsh-kurowhale-pet README · 安装：需要 **Windows x64、WebView2 和 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 或 rc.5**。

1. 打开 DSH Desktop 的 **插件管理 → 添加插件**。
2. 输入 `dsh-kurowhale-pet@0.1.4`，选择 **npm 官方源**，点击 **安装**。
3. 安装完成后点击 **立即启用**，再重启 DSH。

首次启动会优先使用包内素材；缺失的素材和官方 Neutralino 6.9.0 运行时会从固定来源联网获取并校验 SHA-256。已有自定义路径、显示偏好和位置予以保留。下载或校验失败会记录错误，DSH 仍可使用。同名插件已安装时，Desktop 要求先卸载再安装，请先备份配置。

dsh-kurowhale-pet README · Installation：Requires **Windows x64, WebView2, and DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 or rc.5**.

1. Open **Plugin management → Add plugin** in DSH Desktop.
2. Enter `dsh-kurowhale-pet@0.1.4`, select the **official npm registry**, and click **Install**.
3. Click **Enable now** when installation finishes, then restart DSH.

dsh-kurowhale-pet README · Installation：The first launch prefers bundled artwork. Missing artwork and the official Neutralino 6.9.0 runtime are downloaded from pinned sources and verified with SHA-256. Existing custom paths, visibility preferences, and position are retained. Download or verification failures are logged while DSH remains usable. Desktop requires uninstalling a same-name plugin before reinstalling it; back up your configuration first.

dsh-kurowhale-pet README · Installation：**v0.1.4 npm is published:** [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-kurowhale-pet/v/0.1.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-kurowhale-pet/releases) · [Bilingual release notes](docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.1.4.md)

dsh-kurowhale-pet README · Features and preview：

Extracted and arranged from the existing `spritesheet.webp` referenced by `pet.json`. The character and animations are unchanged. See [artwork version maintenance](docs/ARTWORK-VERSIONS.md) for reproduction details.

dsh-kurowhale-pet README · Verified scope：Installation and desktop interaction were verified on Windows x64 with DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3; installation and targeted stability regression were also checked on rc.5. Other DSH versions, mixed-DPI setups, and long-running use have not been fully validated. See the [technical acceptance record](docs/TECHNICAL-ACCEPTANCE-0.1.0.md) and [this round's record](docs/POST-RELEASE-0.1.3.md) for evidence and limitations.

dsh-kurowhale-pet README · Artwork and licensing：The character was created with **AI assistance** and developed into animated assets. Its references include a whale-girl image found through Google Images. That image closely resembles the character in [PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet), but its direct creator, original source, and permission scope are not fully confirmed. The reference image itself is not included in the release.
